artifacts.notes: One original title leaf only; it identifies Nicola Franco, lecture delivery 4 December 1910, Rome, Riccardo Garroni and 1912. It contains no original body passage, Elbasan altar book, approbation or local receipt evidence.
artifacts.rights_basis: Narrow original 1912 printed title leaf only: a faithful flat scan with no modern reset body or editorial footer. Under the repository’s United States treatment of historical foreign publications, the maximum 95-year term for the 1912 publication has expired; Circular 15A pp. 2–3 supplies duration/restoration support. Mechanical extraction adds no authorship. This basis does not license the modern digital body or apply in other jurisdictions.

edition.publication: Undated online presentation by Giuseppina and Pietro Di Marco, combining an original scanned title leaf with a modern reset body.
edition.title: Necessità di mantenere il rito greco in Mezzojuso: Di Marco online presentation

alternate_titles: Necessità di Mantenere il Rito Greco in Mezzojuso
work.author: Nicola Franco
work.description: Lecture defending the Greek rite in Mezzojuso. This is a historical source concerning Catholic communities, not a Eucharistic celebrant book.
